ru.title: Новая методология для кросс-язычной диагностики депрессии
ru.desc: В статье представлена новая методология CLeaD для распознавания депрессии на основе речи, которая объединяет эмбеддинги WavLM на английском и мандаринском языках в общую клиническую область. Это решение направлено на преодоление проблем с кросс-язычной генерализацией и устранение искажений, вызванных утечкой идентичности говорящего. Метод показывает небольшое, но значимое улучшение по сравнению с базовым уровнем в задачах диагностики депрессии. Результаты показывают, что увеличение размера модели ухудшает кросс-язычную производительность, при этом утечка идентичности говорящего раздувает ранее зарегистрированные метрики.

en.title: Bridging Languages for Better Depression Detection
en.desc: This paper introduces CLeaD, a supervised contrastive alignment framework that aligns WavLM embeddings from English and Mandarin for detecting depression. It addresses the challenge of cross-lingual generalization by avoiding speaker identity leakage, which can inflate performance metrics. The framework shows improved performance in detecting depression in Mandarin speakers compared to previous methods. The study highlights that while model scaling enhances monolingual performance, it can degrade cross-lingual results.

papers.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
papers.abstract: Abstract Image2Sim enables scalable embodied navigation training by creating high-fidelity interactive environments from RGB-D images through decoupled 3D spatial anchoring and photorealistic rendering techniques.  Generated by Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct Embodied navigation aims to build agents that interpret multimodal goals, reason in 3D space, and reach target destinations reliably in the real world. However, progress remains constrained by the lack of scalable, high-fidelity, and physically grounded interactive environments. Although real-world scanned datasets offer visual realism, they are limited by scale. In contrast, synthetic simulators scale more easily but often exhibit large sim-to-real gaps. We introduce Image2Sim, a real-time neural simulation framework that constructs high-quality interactive environments from posed RGB-D image sequences. The central idea is to decouple 3D spatial anchoring from photorealistic observation synthesis. For scene construction, Image2Sim uses a feed-forward feature Gaussian model that lifts posed RGB-D observations into a 3D feature-Gaussian representation in a single pass. For rendering, we propose a Geometry-Aware One-Step Pixel Flow model that transforms sparse and noisy Gaussian projections into high-quality panoramic RGB-D observations. Image2Sim also serves as a fully automated embodied data engine that generates high-fidelity observations, executable actions, and diverse navigation instructions at scale. It converts large collections of videos and images into nearly 20K interactive scenes and synthesizes more than 10 million navigation training samples. Navigation models trained entirely in these neural environments achieve strong improvements on major benchmarks and transfer effectively to real-world zero-shot settings. These results suggest that scalable neural simulation can serve as a practical training substrate for embodied navigation at scale.

ru.title: Нейросимуляция для обучения embodied навигации
ru.desc: Статья представляет Image2Sim, систему для обучения навигации с использованием высококачественных интерактивных сред, созданных из RGB-D изображений. Технология разделяет 3D пространственное якорение и фотореалистичное рендеринг, что позволяет строить сцены в реальном времени. Image2Sim генерирует до 20 000 интерактивных сцен и синтезирует более 10 миллионов образцов для обучения навигационным моделям. Результаты показывают, что такая нейросимуляция превосходит традиционные методы и эффективно переносится в реальные условия.

en.title: Scalable Neural Simulation for Enhanced Navigation Training
en.desc: Image2Sim is a framework that creates realistic interactive environments for training navigation agents using RGB-D images. It separates the processes of 3D spatial anchoring and photorealistic rendering to enhance the quality of simulated environments. By generating nearly 20,000 interactive scenes and over 10 million navigation samples, it allows for scalable training of navigation models. These models show significant performance improvements on benchmarks and can effectively transfer to real-world scenarios without additional training.
